name: Stick Walker VR
summary:
Stick Walker VR could be the hardest VR challenge ever created!

In this intense physics-based survival experience, you must learn to walk using only metal sticks while navigating dangerous music-reactive floors, brutal obstacles, moving platforms, and precision balance sections designed to push your coordination to the limit.

There’s one simple rule: DO NOT TOUCH THE FLOOR.

The moment your feet hit the ground, it’s game over.

What starts as a simple movement challenge quickly becomes a true test of skil
